title: Equivariant families of geometric germs are sections over a field
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in $\mathrm{Type}\,u$, with compatible embeddings $K\to K_s\to\Omega$, where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$, and $w=\max(u+1,v)$. Let $F$ be a sheaf with values in $\mathrm{Type}\,w$ on the small etale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and let $p$ be the geometric point defined by $K\to\Omega$, with stalk $p^*F$ and germ maps $\gamma_{Y,y}:F(Y)\to p^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Suppose $\rho:G\to(p^*F\to p^*F)$ satisfies $\rho(g)(\gamma_{Y,y}(z))=\gamma_{Y,y^{\prime}}(z)$ whenever $\tau:\Omega\simeq_K\Omega$ extends $g$ and $y^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ y$. No action laws for $\rho$ need be assumed separately. For any etale $K$-scheme $X$ and function $f:p(X)\to p^*F$ satisfying $f(x^{\prime})=\rho(g)(f(x))$ whenever $\tau$ extends $g$ and $x^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ x$, there exists $z\in F(X)$ such that $\gamma_{X,x}(z)=f(x)$ for every lift $x\in p(X)$. The assertion includes empty $X$.

source.place: Tag 04JM, direct proof of lemma-global-sections-point; Tag 03QW, section-galois-action-stalks, including nonalgebraic geometric points

proof.text: The structure morphism of X is etale, hence locally quasi-finite. Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton makes its fibre as a subset discrete. Spec K is a singleton, so this subset is all of X. Its singleton open subschemes Y_i form a covering family a_i:Y_i -> X, including the empty covering for empty X. Each Y_i is nonempty and subsingleton. Compose the change-of-lift equation with a_i to check covariance of the pulled-back germ family. Apply lem-exc-field-equivariant-germs-one-point to obtain z_i on Y_i with the prescribed germs.

Prove germ extensionality for an arbitrary base scheme S and geometric point s, assuming the lifts of the etale object cover its underlying points. Equal germs give pointed refinements where restrictions agree, by Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff'. These refinements make the equalizer sieve covering, and sheaf separatedness gives equality. In the field case, exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed supplies the lift-covering hypothesis. On any common refinement b:W -> Y_i, c:W -> Y_j with b a_i = c a_j, germ naturality says the restrictions of z_i and z_j both have germs f at the same lift. Apply the generalized germ-extensionality helper with the field lift-covering argument to make these restrictions equal.

Apply Mathlib Presheaf.IsSheaf.existsUnique_amalgamation_ofArrows to glue the compatible sections z_i, represented as maps from PUnit. For any geometric lift x, Point.jointly_surjective lifts x through the covering sieve, hence through a refinement of some a_i. The amalgamation equation and Point.toPresheafFiber_w_apply identify the glued germ with f(x). When X is empty the same argument uses the empty covering and yields a section without applying the one-point lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem field_equivariant_germ_family_section
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v))) :
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∀ (ρ : Gal(Ks/K) → p.sheafFiber.obj F → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
      (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
        (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
          τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
        (Y : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (y y' : p.fiber.obj Y)
        (hy : y'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ y.left)
        (z : F.obj.obj (op Y)),
        ρ g (p.toPresheafFiber Y y F.obj z) = p.toPresheafFiber Y y' F.obj z) →
      ∀ (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (f : p.fiber.obj X → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
        (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
          (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left),
          f x' = ρ g (f x)) →
        ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op X), ∀ x : p.fiber.obj X,
          p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z = f x
